title: Medicines, three positions · TPMT
summary: This reads three TPMT positions and tries to name the pair of TPMT forms you carry, which the 2025 guideline (PMID 41618934) needs. It cannot always do so. When one copy carries the *3B change and one copy carries the *3C change, the file does not say whether they sit on the same copy (*1/*3A) or on different copies (*3B/*3C), and those two pairs get different answers.

interpretations.CC: No *2 change at this position on either copy.
interpretations.CG: One copy carries the *2 change at this position.
interpretations.GG: Both copies carry the *2 change at this position.

interpretations.CC: No *3B change at this position on either copy.
interpretations.CT: One copy carries the *3B change at this position. With one *3C change too, the pair is *1/*3A or *3B/*3C and the file cannot tell which.
interpretations.TT: Both copies carry the *3B change at this position.
No *3C change at this position on either copy.
interpretations.CT: One copy carries the *3C change (C) at this position. With one *3B change too, the pair is *1/*3A or *3B/*3C and the file cannot tell which.
interpretations.CC: Both copies carry the *3C change (C) at this position.

interpretations.TT: No *41 change at this position on either copy.
interpretations.GT: One copy carries the *41 change (G) at this position.
interpretations.GG: Both copies carry the *41 change (G) at this position.

citations.label: CPIC guideline for TPMT and NUDT15 and thiopurine dosing, 2025 update, Clin Pharmacol Ther 2026
